Summary
: The English translation of the Bhagavad-Gita Rahasya, also known as the Karma-yoga Shastra or “Science of Right Action”, composed in Marathi by Bal Gangadhar Tilak in 1915. This first volume represents an esoteric exposition of the Bhagavadgita and interprets the verses from a Mimamsa philosophical standpoint. The work contains 15 chapters, Sanskrit text and additional footnotes.
Alternative titles: Śrīmadbhagavadgītārahasya (श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतारहस्य, Srimadbhagavadgitarahasya), Śrīmad-bhagavadgītā-rahasya (श्रीमद्-भगवद्गीता-रहस्य, Srimad-bhagavadgita-rahasya), Bhagavadgītārahasya (भगवद्गीतारहस्य, Bhagavadgitarahasya), Gītārahasya (गीतारहस्य, Gitarahasya), गीता-रहस्य (गीतारहस्य), Karmayogaśāstra (कर्मयोगशास्त्र, Karmayogashastra, Karmayogasastra), Karmayoga (कर्मयोग), Karma-yoga-śāstra (कर्म-योग-शास्त्र, Karma-yoga-shastra)
